topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: It's such a whirlwind of news, really! My best friend and I, we’ve spent countless nights talking about dreams and ambitions, and now, here we are, standing at the edge of one of hers coming true. She's found this amazing opportunity across the country, and the excitement in her voice was contagious as she told me. We're already dreaming up visits and adventures. It's a chapter change, but it’s also a thrilling start to new possibilities. I'm looking forward to watching her thrive in this new setting, and I can’t wait to join her for some of the journey, however far away it might be. This is just the beginning of a new, exciting phase for both of us!
